scripts.check:all: npm run check:types && npm run prettier:check && npm run lint:check && npm run check:boundary && npm run check:boundary:ast
scripts.check:boundary: node -e "const s = require('child_process').execSync('git status -s apps/995.library/995.library/').toString().trim(); if (s) { console.error('BOUNDARY BREACH:', s); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.check:artifacts: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); function scan(d) { for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) { const p = path.join(d, e.name); if (e.isDirectory() && e.name !== 'node_modules' && e.name !== 'dist') scan(p); else if (e.isFile() && (e.name.endsWith('.js') || e.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) && !e.name.includes('.config.')) { console.error(':: [FAIL] Leaked artifact in source:', p); process.exit(1); } } } scan('packages/300.engine'); console.log('PASS: Zero leaked compilation artifacts in packages/300.engine');"
scripts.check:zero-runtime: node -e "const pkg = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); if (pkg.dependencies && Object.keys(pkg.dependencies).length > 0) { console.error('FAIL: Root dependencies must be empty'); process.exit(1); } console.log('PASS: Zero root runtime dependencies verified');"
scripts.fix: npm run prettier:fix && npm run lint:fix
scripts.clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:ts
